alias_of.description: The model an alias points at, when the list says (AI-78).

allowed.description: On the connection's allow-list: the models a route may name (AI-72).

context_window.description: The context window the list reports: a hint the probe still proves.

max_output.description: The most output tokens the list reports.

pending_price.description: A price waiting for the Owner's review: a normalised match, or a rate that fell by more than half (AI-85).

price.description: Its price in force, with its source (AI-82).

price_checked.description: When its price was last looked for.

priced.description: It has a price in force.

probe.description: The last probe on this connection: a few tokens of synthetic text (AI-80).

qualifications.description: Its latest run of each agent's evals on this connection: it serves an agent only on a pass that is not out of date (AI-78, AI-87).

reports.description: What the list reports it supports, as the provider names it: hints, never proof (AI-71).

items.description: What the list reports, as the provider names it: a hint, never proof (AI-71).

serves.description: It may serve a route as far as its price goes: a usage-based connection's model needs a price in force, as its cost could not otherwise be budgeted; a subscription or a self-hosted server needs none (AI-82).

shutdown.description: The provider's retirement or shutdown date (AI-84).

state.description: new: first listed in the last 7 days; deprecated: a shutdown date ahead; no_longer_listed: not in the last complete read, or past its shutdown; not_callable: the provider refused it (AI-81).

unpriced.description: Why the last look found no new price for it: never priced by a guess (AI-82).
examples: no entry of anthropic names claude-test-9
